messages.text:
I'm here and awake; nothing broke while you were away, and one phone step waits for you.
- The rendering work is done (best build g0.0l); the Part 1 day-by-day draft has its figures and 8 real iPhone GIFs: https://claude.ai/artifact/<private-artifact>
- Waiting on you 1: step C-140, unlock the iPhone, check Settings > Developer > Enable UI Automation, re-plug the cable, press Done. Then the people-card phone check (g0.0m, about 1 h) starts.
- Waiting on you 2 (T-170, the blog thread): "plan OK" for the remaining recorded pictures, "strip yes" for the people-card strip, and your "My thoughts" text.
- Nothing else is running; the hourly team reports were all on target overnight.
What you need to do: do C-140 if you want the people-card check; otherwise tell me what to work on next.

Correction: you already pressed Done on C-140 (thank you); I am starting the iPhone's test driver now.
- If it comes up, the people-card phone check (g0.0m, about 1 h) starts right after; I post the result in T-228 (the best-builds thread).
- If it still fails, I look at its log first and only ask you again with a reason.
What you need to do: nothing now; leave the iPhone plugged in and unlocked.

The iPhone's test driver is working again (ready at 02:52 UTC), so the people-card phone check (g0.0m) is starting now.
- It takes about 1 hour on the phone; I post the result in T-228 (the best-builds thread).
- If it passes, g0.0m becomes the new best build; if not, g0.0l stays.
What you need to do: nothing; please leave the iPhone plugged in and don't use it for the next hour.
